insight.primary: Outbound connectivity to payments-api is blocked
insight.detail: Pod 'api-client-pod' in namespace 'default' cannot establish outbound connections to Service 'payments-api' on port 8443. Requests are timing out while the service itself still has healthy endpoints.
Service 'payments-api' in namespace 'default' has a ready backend endpoint. The service backend is healthy, so the connectivity failure is likely caused by policy or network path restrictions.
